The software product **Iubenda** at **iubenda.com** is directly provided by **iubenda s.r.l.**

### Evidence
According to the official **Terms and Conditions of www.iubenda.com**:
> *"This Website is provided by:  
> **iubenda s.r.l.**  
> Via Aosta 4, 20155 Milan (Italy)  
> Milan Chamber of Commerce EU VAT No: IT07347120961 ... Company subject to the direction and coordination of team.blue NV."*

Furthermore, the site's Legal & Privacy Hub states:
> *"iubenda s.r.l. is based in Milan, Italy, and is part of the team.blue group."*
